PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.blocked_by: Growing the frozen stem-feature vocabulary needs an evidence packet for the feature, and is outside this pilot's authorization.
PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.normalized_feature: severe acute chest pain is the presenting complaint
PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.why: It is the presentation every competitor in this set shares with the key and the reason a candidate considers an aortic cause at all. Without it dissection is expressible only as its own correctness conditions.
PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.why_not_eligible: The wave refused the candidate outright, and the feature it would have needed is not in the frozen vocabulary.

PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.s4_limb_b: CLM-R2-OB-CONTINUE-FEEDING states that bacterial mastitis is not a contraindication to breastfeeding and that women should not be told to express and discard. The claim exists because the presence of bacterial mastitis is the recognized reason clinicians reach for this instruction, and CLM-R2-OB-MASTITIS-ANCHOR states that mastitis as the segmental erythematous, oedematous, painful breast. It is the presentation feature this candidate shares with the key.
PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.s4_limb_c: The candidate's correctness condition is that a contraindication to the infant receiving the milk is present. Segmental erythema is not that condition and does not appear in its tree, so the anchor makes the candidate live without making it correct.
PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.why_not_eligible: FEATURE_ANCHOR_SNAPSHOT_V2 does not assert this anchor relation for SEED-OB-T03-DISCARD. The pinned snapshot is not rebuilt inside the batch, so the relation is invisible to every item in it and is carried to the next snapshot cycle for independent review.

PROPOSED_EXTENSIONS_FOR_NEXT_SNAPSHOT.why: CLM-R4-PED-FEEDING names this number as the aspiration-risk threshold. The frozen vocabulary can only say escalating work of breathing, which collapses a measured vital sign into the judgement that non-invasive support is being considered, and that collapse is what makes three competitors share one anchor.

Rhinorrhea is the nasal secretion suctioning addresses, and CLM-R4-PED-SUCTION is a claim about suctioning in exactly that illness. The coryzal prodrome is the presentation feature the candidate shares with the key.

A coryzal prodrome is not that condition -- an infant may be coryzal without obstruction limiting feeds -- so the anchor makes the candidate live without making it correct.

cache_economics.amortization_note: Reuse inside one opportunity is real -- one anchor relation served three members in both the surgical and the psychiatric sets -- and reuse across opportunities was zero, because each opportunity is a different study unit or a different learner decision. Nothing here supports a monetary estimate and none is offered.
cache_economics.feature_registry_cache_hits: The pinned snapshot is loaded once per run and its hash verified once; every consumer reads the same in-memory rows. No feature or anchor row was re-derived per opportunity.

context_characters.tokens_not_reported_because: No local tokenizer is installed, and characters are not equated with tokens.
context_characters.why: The serialized pairwise relation payload is again the whole of the supply cost, and it is again unoptimized. The registry gives every anchor relation a stable content-addressed id, which is the precondition for sending a reference instead of re-serializing a competitor's full anchor and condition payload on each of the six to ten pairs an opportunity builds. This pilot measured it and deliberately did not change it.

eligibility.limitation: The batch is 6, against a specified 36 and a stated floor of 24. The shortfall is the canonical opportunity universe, not the selection rule: the whole frozen universe is 30, only 18 carry an authored option-set contract, 16 of those reach three admissible curated candidates, and 10 are consumed by the V2 frozen-ten replay. Reaching 24 would require authoring new opportunities, new seed packs with independent seed review and new evidence packets, which is source-packet research rather than an architecture pilot. No criterion was weakened and no opportunity was invented.

failure_taxonomy.not_repaired_here: Phase 25's own rule: the defect is identified and is not repaired inside the experiment that measured it.

snapshot_invariant: One snapshot for the whole batch, pinned by explicit id, never rebuilt inside it. Every anchor relation the wave approved that the snapshot does not already assert was withheld from every item in the batch and recorded for the next snapshot cycle. The counterfactual run beside each opportunity is what those withheld relations would have bought; it is reported, not counted.

supply_source_value.load_bearing_for_accepted_questions: None, because no question was accepted. The one item the counterfactual realized rested on three anchor relations, all of them read from claims already in the frozen evidence packets and none of them from the graph or the full-text index.
supply_source_value.tn_fts_note: One bounded full-text query was run for each of five opportunities. Every concept returned was already a frozen curated seed for that decision, so the index contributed no candidate and no relation. That is the second consecutive wave in which it has contributed nothing.
